description: Verify a Base (Ethereum L2) transaction and report every USDC Transfer event in it: sender, recipient, amount, block number, on-chain success, and confirmation age. Free, no account, reads Base's public JSON-RPC live. Example you can call right now, no setup: {"tx": "0xad887d8844d9d8b093b8040c1950e66b7cf3c9f3c98644bed7fb911c6a2e8079"} -- a real, already-settled USDC transfer, always returns found:true.
name: verify_base_usdc_tx
